{{Quote|Oh, how I've waited for you, Jedi. Hundreds and hundreds of years trapped here, waiting for ''another'' Jedi."''<br />"''Let me loose and I'll bring my Jedi friends. We can have a party.|Rajine and Mace Windu|<ref name="NWO" />}}
'''Rajine''' was a [[Count/Legends|countess]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who lived during the final [[Time/Legends|centuries]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Additionally, she was an [[Energy Vampire]] and was capable of draining an individual's life-force. Eventually, the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Samuro]] recognized the threat that Rajine posed and [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] her in a [[Unidentified city (Rajine's planet)|city]] on a [[Rajine's planet|remote planet]]. After Samuro [[Death/Legends|died]] while erecting a [[Force barrier/Legends|Force barrier]] over the [[Planet/Legends|world]], rendering Rajine unable to leave the [[City/Legends|city]], she took Samuro's [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]], [[Z-18]], for herself.

Over a span of hundreds of years, Rajine used her ability of draining her victims' life-forces to turn them into mindless [[Zombie/Legends|zombies]] under her service. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] visited Rajine's city in search of the [[Alpha-2 Squad]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], which had gone missing there. When Windu entered the city, she began to slowly drain the Jedi's life-force, and imprisoned him. However, Z-18 freed Windu and gave him [[Samuro's Jedi holocron|Samuro's holocron]]. Windu confronted Rajine and used the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] to recite an incantation that freed the life-forces of the zombies under the Countess's control. The zombies turned against Rajine, killing her and ending her threat to the Jedi.

==Biography==
===Early life and imprisonment===
{{Dialogue|Rajine|What is that?|Windu|A message from the past.|Samuro's holocron|Hello, Rajine. If you are listening to this, it means a Jedi has found you. I alone was not strong enough to destroy the evil that you are. I could only contain you. I was only able to trap you here, but not only you&mdash;''all'' of the victims whose life-forces you have drained. ''All'' of their life-forces are trapped here with you. As a Jedi I cannot seek revenge, but all of these lives are quite vengeful. They are ''lost''. Alone I could only trap you, but with another Jedi to speak the words of banishment your doom is sealed&hellip;the words to awaken the lost&hellip;|attr=Rajine, Mace Windu, and Samuro's holocron|src=<ref name="NWO" />}}
[[File:Samuro.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Jedi Knight Samuro sacrificed himself to imprison Rajine and the victims of her life-draining abilities on a remote planet.]]
[[Countess/Legends|Countess]] Rajine was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the final [[Time/Legends|centuries]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="CSWE" /> As an [[Energy Vampire]], she was capable of draining the life-forces of individuals. The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Samuro]] eventually recognized the threat that Rajine posed and [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] the Countess and her victims in a [[Unidentified city (Rajine's planet)|city]] on a [[Rajine's planet|remote world]]. Samuro [[Death/Legends|died]] using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to raise a [[Force barrier/Legends|barrier]] that ensured that Rajine and her victims would never be able to leave the [[City/Legends|city]].<ref name="NWO" />

The deceased Jedi Knight's [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]] kept Rajine and her victims confined in the city over a span of several centuries. During her confinement, Rajine kept Samuro's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and [[Samuro's Jedi holocron|Jedi holocron]], and additionally claimed Samuro's [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]], [[Z-18]], for herself.<ref name="NWO" /> Over the years, Rajine continued to drain the life-forces out of [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]], turning them into mindless [[Zombie/Legends|zombies]] to do her bidding.<ref name="CSWE" />

===The arrival of Mace Windu===
{{Quote|Oh, how I've waited for you, Jedi. Hundreds and hundreds of years trapped here, waiting for ''another'' Jedi.|Rajine to Mace Windu|<ref name="NWO" />}}
[[File:Zombies.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Rajine's zombies capture Jedi Master Mace Windu.]]
Hundreds of years later,<ref name="NWO" /> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] and [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Date" />, the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] arrived at Rajine's [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in search of the [[Alpha-2 Squad]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], whose last transmission had come from the city in which Rajine was imprisoned. When Windu was escorted into the city by Z-18, Rajine began to drain his life-force. While investigating the city, Windu found that the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] were dead and was subsequently captured by Rajine's zombies.<ref name="NWO" />

After imprisoning him, the Countess confronted Windu and informed him that she had waited centuries for another Jedi to arrive on her world. The Jedi Master found that he was unable to [[Telekinesis/Legends|summon]] his lightsaber to him with the Force, and Rajine informed him that it was because she had been draining his life-force from the instant that he crossed the city's front gate. She revealed that she intended to gather all of Windu's life-force and use it to escape the planet.<ref name="NWO" />

===Death===
{{Quote|Join us, Rajine&hellip;''"<br />"''W&mdash;What? No! No!! Nooooooo&hellip;|The zombies attack and kill Rajine|<ref name="NWO" />}}
Rajine tried to convince Windu to succumb to her life-draining abilities, but the Jedi recognized that she was an Energy Vampire and insulted her. Rajine remarked that she would live longer than he would and took Windu's lightsaber, leaving and ordering Z-18 to follow her.<ref name="NWO" />

When she later discovered that Windu had escaped, Rajine sent her zombies to look for him throughout the city. After finding him, Rajine punched Windu, knocking the Jedi to the ground. She also destroyed Z-18&mdash;who had freed the Jedi&mdash;using Windu's lightsaber, remarking that she should not have kept the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] after Samuro died. Windu then activated Samuro's [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]], which had been given to him by Z-18. The holocron's image of Samuro spoke to the Countess and revealed that she would be defeated when the image and Windu spoke the "words of banishment." After Samuro's image and Windu recited the incantation,<ref name="NWO" /> the zombies' wills were restored to them.<ref name="CSWE" /> When she ordered them to kill Windu, Rajine's victims turned against her and killed her.<ref name="NWO" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|And you, Z-18! I should never have let you stick around after Samuro died!"''<br />"''Yes, ma'am."''<br />"''Never disobey me!|Rajine destroys Z-18|<ref name="NWO" />}}
The Energy Vampire Rajine once served the Jedi Order as a Jedi. However, the Jedi Knight Samuro recognized the threat she posed. After she and her victims were imprisoned on the remote world by Samuro, Rajine was determined to escape. She eagerly awaited the day when another Jedi would come to her world. When she spoke with Mace Windu, she taunted the Jedi Master and his abilities with the Force, referring to the Force powers as "Jedi magic." Rajine treated the droid Z-18 as an irritant and frequently talked down to him. After she discovered that Z-18 had freed Windu, Rajine destroyed the droid. Rajine had [[Color/Legends|purple]] skin, violet [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and white [[Hair/Legends|hair]].<ref name="NWO" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|As soon as you crossed the front gate, I began to drain your life-force. And once I have absorbed it all, I will have the power to escape this prison! You look tired. Don't fight it. Just give in&hellip;you can't win.''"<br />"''An Energy Vampire. I should have guessed. Nothing more than a ''parasite''.|Rajine and Mace Windu|<ref name="NWO" />}}
Before being imprisoned on a remote world by Jedi Knight Samuro, Rajine served as a Jedi.<ref name="CSWE" /> As an Energy Vampire, she was capable of draining the life-forces of individuals. She turned her victims into zombies and managed to retain control of them for several hundred centuries. She also used Mace Windu's lightsaber to destroy the droid Z-18.<ref name="NWO" />

==Equipment==
Rajine wore a red and purple [[Clothing/Legends|dress]], a red [[Belt/Legends|belt]], and [[Gold/Legends|golden]] [[Piercing/Legends|earrings]].<ref name="NWO" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rajine was introduced in the short [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] ''[[No Way Out]]'', which was one of four stories compiled in the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures Volume 9|ninth volume]] of the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (graphic novels)|''Clone Wars Adventures'']] [[Star Wars comic books|trade paperback]]. The comic was illustrated by brothers [[Matthew Fillbach|Matthew]] and [[Shawn Fillbach|Shawn]] [[Fillbach Brothers|Fillbach]], who also scripted ''No Way Out'',<ref name="NWO" /> and published on [[October 31]], [[2007]].<ref name="Amazon">{{DarkHorse|url=Books/13-623/Star-Wars-Clone-Wars-Adventures-Volume-9|text=Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures Volume 9}}</ref>
